craft_claim: Unreliable narration generates dramatic irony and psychological tension by establishing a discernible discrepancy between narrator perception and narrative reality.

supporting_evidence.note: Booth defines an unreliable narrator as one whose norms diverge significantly from those of the implied author.
Raju self-servingly rationalizes his manipulation of Rosie and Marco, while the narrative framing exposes his vanity.

scope: First-person and limited third-person narrative fiction.
